brief_summary: Four-panel numbered process strip for the H2 'A regular light-cleaning routine'. Panel 1: a bulb-style manual duster aimed at a small key row with dashed air-burst lines. Panel 2: two adjacent keycaps with an amber dotted highlight in the gap between them and a brush tip working into that gap. Panel 3: a keycap lifted clear of its housing by a puller, exposed stem below, with an amber lift arrow. Panel 4: a folded microfiber cloth wiping a flat case-top line with motion arcs. Each panel gets a numbered amber chip and a sans caption. Matches the body's four practices verbatim — duster, brush for switch gaps and stabilizer wells, keycap-puller spot checks, microfiber wipe — no fabricated steps.
